outcome: Outer Blackboard can supersede a materially stale RESEARCH_SA objective through an explicit trusted publication without allowing the candidate research branch to redefine its own evaluation subject.
currentProblem: BB-065's benchmark premise was reset from a six-pair value study to neutral substrate calibration, but the canonical objective is intentionally trusted-main data and ordinary research candidates may contribute only plan draft plus research baseline. There is no controlled path to change a current objective while preserving anti-self-redefinition, provenance and downstream impact.
constraints: Ordinary RESEARCH_SA candidates must remain unable to change objectiveRef, objective content or planRef used by their own Jev readiness evaluation.
An objective supersession is a distinct publication/control-plane action, not a readiness result, worker result or Jev semantic pass.
The previous objective and its historical plans/evaluations remain auditable; supersession must not rewrite prior Git history or relabel prior evidence.
Supersession must bind exact work id, old objective hash, replacement objective hash/content, reason/evidence, affected plan and direct downstream tasks before publication.

Publishing a replacement objective must revoke stale readiness/evaluation authority, reset the affected task to RESEARCH_SA/RESEARCH with a DRAFT plan bound to the replacement objective, and remove any active claim/context.
The replacement objective does not become delivered product truth and cannot mark the affected task DONE.
The first migration target is BB-065; BB-082 must establish the generic control before a separate BB-065 supersession publication uses it.
successCriteria: A canonical OBJECTIVE_SUPERSESSION proposal/publication contract binds exact old/new objective identities, rationale/evidence, affected plan and direct dependency impact while retaining an immutable supersession record.
Trusted CI accepts an objective supersession only through the dedicated publication path and continues rejecting ordinary research branches that alter their trusted objective or routing identity.

A valid supersession atomically leaves the target task non-active in RESEARCH_SA/RESEARCH with a DRAFT plan bound to the new objective, stale readiness/evaluation/worker authority cleared, and rebuildable context absent until the task is claimed again.

Negative tests reject stale-old-objective races, wrong work/plan refs, hidden downstream impact, status/readiness preservation, objective mutation inside ordinary readiness, and attempts to rewrite DONE/WORKER task truth.

After the control is delivered, a separate BB-065 migration can replace the obsolete six-pair objective with neutral benchmark-substrate calibration without rerunning or rewriting the historical value-study evidence.
